title: Tailoring & Skill Training Workshop – Uppal
summary: 18 women completed a 3-month tailoring and embroidery training batch, 11 now earning independently.
description: Our Uppal skill center runs rolling 3-month batches teaching tailoring, embroidery, and basic garment costing to women from nearby low-income neighborhoods. This batch graduated 18 women; 11 have since taken up stitching orders independently or joined local garment units, and 4 have started home-based tailoring businesses supported with a starter sewing machine from Prayas Seva.
